senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. רבע)to lie down, esp. to break down under a load.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 33a:1">B. Mets. 33ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00141"><he>רַבְצָן</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <he>רָבוּץ</he>; f. <cite ref="T00799"><he>רְבוּצָה</he></cite> &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 7:4:4">Y. B. Kam. VII, end, 6ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא ראוהו ר׳</he> perhaps they saw him in the act of slaughtering after the ox was laid down, opp. <he>ראוהו מושך</he> they saw him pull the ox into the woods to kill him. Y. Naz. V, 54ᶜ <he>ר׳</he> lying, opp. <he>עומד</he>.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 54a">Ab. Zar. 54ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 40a:4">Ḥull. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>היתה … ר׳ וכ׳</he> if his neighbor’s beast was laid down before an idol (to be sacrificed). Y. R. Hash. II, beg. 57ᵈ <he>ראיתיו ר׳ בין וכ׳</he> I saw it (the moon, like an animal) lying between two rocks; Tosef. ib. I, 15 <he>רוֹבֵץ</he>; Bab.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 22b">R. Hash. 22ᵇ</cite>.

R. s. 14</cite> <he>בהמה … ר׳ וכ׳</he> the quadruped walks with her body in a horizontal position, … but woman walks erect; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 546">Yalk. Lev. 546</cite>; Tanḥ. Thazr. 3 <he>הבהמה … והולד ר׳ וכ׳</he> the animal walks and her embryo lies horizontally &c., opp. <he>זקוף</he>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. רְבִיעָה) to irrigate by sprinkling, contrad. to השקה. Y. Peah V, 19ᵃ top; Tosef. ib. II, 20 המְרַבֵּץ את שדהו וכ׳ (ed. Zuck. המַרְבִּיץ) if one irrigates his field, before the poor have entered it.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:10">Shebi. II, 10</cite> <he>מְרַבְּצִין בעפר לבן</he> Y. ed. (Mish. a. Bab. ed. <he>מַרְבִּיצִין</he>) you may (in the Sabbatical year) irrigate ‘blank’ soil (a vegetable or grain field, v. <cite ref="L00099"><he>לָבָן</he></cite>); Y. ib. 34ᵇ; Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᶜ; Bab.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 6b:9">M. Kat. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>מרביצין שדה וכ׳</he>.
Tosef. ib. I, 2 מרצפין (corr. acc.); a. e.—Esp. to sprinkle (a floor in order to lay the dust &c.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:6">Snh. VII, 6</cite> <he>המכבד והמרבץ</he> he who sweeps or sprinkles (before an idol); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 348:2">Yalk. Ex. 348</cite> <he>והמרביץ</he>. Y. Sabb. II, end, 5ᶜ; Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 95a:6">Sabb. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>מְרַבֶּצֶת ביתה וכ׳</he> may contrive to sprinkle her room on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Shabbat 95a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>הרוצה לרַבֵּץ וכ׳</he> he who desires to sprinkle &c. Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵈ, v. <cite ref="A01819"><he>אֲלוּנְטִית</he> II</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:1">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:11">V</cite>), 11 <he>ולא רִיבַּצְתִּי עליהם וכ׳</he> I sprinkled no liquids on them (the herbs, to keep them fresh).

senses.gloss: (with תורה) to spread the Law, to teach. Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ bot. ר׳ … יותר וכ׳ he spread the Law more (has had more pupils) than thou; Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ bot.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 85b:4">B. Mets. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>לא רִיבַּצְתָּ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01114"><he>פִּלְפֵּל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Temurah 16a:59">Tem. 16ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>י̇ע̇ב̇ץ̇</he>, v. <cite ref="J00475"><he>יַעְבֵּץ</he></cite>) <he>שי̇ע̇ץ וריב̇ץ וכ׳</he> he (Othniel) gave advice and taught the Law in Israel.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 25a:19">M. Kat. 25ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to sprinkle, v. supra. Pesik. Par., p. 40ᵇ; Pesik. R. s. 14; Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 6 ומַרְבִּיצִין עליו וכ׳ and they sprinkle water upon him, v. תְּזָוִית.

units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> <he>נפל … והִרְבִּיצָם וכ׳</he> he fell upon his face, and made them (his sons) lie down on their faces, and prayed.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41">Gen. R. s. 41</cite>; s. 69, a. e., v. <cite ref="Q01011"><he>פְּלַטְיָא</he></cite> II h.
Num. R. s. 1 (expl. ויסב, Ex. XIII, 18, cmp. סָבַב Hif.) שהִרְבִּיצָם … רבוצין וכ׳ he made them recline (at meals) like kings lying on their couches.
<cite ref="Exodus 13:18">Ib.</cite> <he>הִרְבַּצְתִּי וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O00562"><he>סִיגְמָטִין</he></cite>; Tanḥ. B’midbar 2; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be besprinkled. Sabb. l. c. ונמצא … מִתְרַבֵּץ מאליו and thus the room is sprinkled of itself.
